inventory.notes: IsDebugger() returns true when a Juggler pipe is connected, so Browser.setIgnoreHTTPSErrors can flip the per-context switch (a page cannot see this). Hunk 2 has 7 logic lines: move the check into one function in our own file and keep a one-line hook. The pipe is looked up by contract id string '@mozilla.org/juggler/remotedebuggingpipe;1'. The include of nsIRemoteDebuggingPipe.h sits under ENABLE_WEBDRIVER. The diff comment calls this a narrower variant of an upstream automation-layer patch; rewrite the comment when moving the code.
